Excellon DMS and Web DMS

A dealer management system that runs a vehicle dealership: leads, quotes, service, parts, finance and e-invoicing in one place. I redesigned the experience from outdated screens to a modern, consistent product.

Design systemsDashboardsData tablesComplex formsDeveloper hand-off
Role
UI/UX designer, end to end
Scope
10+ modules and sub-modules
Platforms
DMS and Web DMS
Tools
Figma, Figma AI, Claude

Screens

The challenge

Many modules, no shared language

Dealership staff moved across many modules to qualify a lead, build a quote and follow up. Screens were dated and looked different in every module, so each one had to be relearned.

Design process

01

Discover

Ran discovery with stakeholders and mapped the lead-to-quote flow.

02

Define

Defined page patterns for lists, forms and detail views.

03

Systemise

Built a library of 500+ icons and components.

04

Design

Designed the 10+ modules on those patterns.

05

Hand off

Reviewed with developers and refined for hand-off.

Key decisions

  • Status chips pair a dot with a label, so meaning is not colour alone.
  • Leads switch between table and card views.
  • A right rail keeps progress, pending tasks and quick actions in view.
  • The amount summary collapses to give quote tables room.

Outcome

10+Modules designed on one shared set of patterns.
500+Reusable icons and components in the system.
40%Business growth contribution through better usability.

Beyond Physique Fit: a 12-week coaching program site

A conversion-focused landing page and application flow for a fitness coaching program, from first promise to secure payment.

Landing pageConversionFront-end buildPayments
Role
Design and front-end build

Payments

Screens

bpf-beyond-physique-fit.vercel.app

The challenge

One page, from offer to payment

A program with a Rs 99 entry offer and two premium plans needed a page that explains the offer, builds trust and gets people through application and payment on a phone.

Design process

01

Promise

Lead with one promise and one action: 12 weeks, real change, Rs 99.

02

Trust

Build trust with a before-and-after results gallery.

03

Plans

Show the three plans side by side so the price ladder is clear.

04

Apply

Split the application into 3 short steps with a progress bar.

05

Pay

Hand off to Razorpay; program materials arrive by email.

Key decisions

  • Short steps keep each screen to a few fields.
  • A soft exit prompt lets people continue later instead of leaving.
  • Every call to action points to the same application.

Outcome

3Short application steps, with a progress bar.
3Plans side by side, starting from Rs 99.
1Application that every call to action points to.
LiveIn production, with payment and automated delivery of materials.

Case study, Ford India

Quick Touch+: Dealer Survey Management Platform

Redesigning how Ford India dealerships collect, manage and analyze customer feedback. Enterprise survey scale, simplified.

UX/UI designDesign systemDashboardEnterprise SaaS
Client
Ford India
Role
Lead UX/UI Designer
Duration
3 months
Tools
Figma
Platforms
Web (desktop and mobile tablet)

Overview

Quick Touch+ is an enterprise survey management platform built for Ford India's dealer network. The system enables dealership staff to create, organize and track customer satisfaction surveys across 200+ dealerships nationwide. I led the end-to-end UX/UI design, from research to final handoff.

The challenge

Transitioning from fragmented spreadsheets to a centralized platform

Ford India's existing survey system was fragmented. Questions were managed through spreadsheets, there was no centralized dashboard, and dealers had no visibility into survey performance or KPIs. The challenge was to build a unified platform that simplifies survey creation, supports multiple languages (English, Hindi, Bengali) and provides real-time analytics.

Design process

01

Research

Deep-dive interviews with 15 Ford India dealership managers to understand workflow friction.

02

Define

Synthesizing requirements, mapping the 10-question constraint limit and localization states.

03

Design

Drafting high-fidelity components, charts, wizards and theme tokens inside the Ford brand system.

04

Test

Interactive walkthroughs with users in Noida and Chennai regions to refine validation checks.

05

Deliver

Handoff of comprehensive design tokens and developer guides for fast implementation.

Features and screens

Survey Question Management

A comprehensive dashboard to view, filter, create and reorder survey questions across categories and languages. Supports active and inactive status management with a 10-question limit.

Add New Question Modal

A streamlined 3-step wizard for creating new questions, with support for multiple response types: Rating, Yes/No, Single Choice, Multiple Choice and Comment. Works in light and dark mode.

KPI Dashboard and Analytics

Hierarchical data visualization showing year-to-date and quarterly performance metrics across India's regional dealer network.

Dark Mode

A full dark theme across all screens for reduced eye strain during extended use.

Design system

Built a consistent design language with Ford brand blue (#003478), a clean component library, light and dark theme tokens, and responsive layouts for desktop and mobile.

Primary palette
#003478#0066FF#0A1128
Typography

Outfit Display

Manrope Regular and Bold for body text

UX outcomes and impact

40%Reduction in task completion time. Survey creation streamlined from 15 min to under 9 min.
3xFaster question reordering. Drag-and-drop replaced manual spreadsheet editing.
95%Task success rate. Users completed survey setup without errors on first attempt.
4.6/5Usability score (SUS). Post-launch user satisfaction across dealership staff.

Case study, mobile app

DSR: Distributor Sales Representative Mobile App

A mobile app for sales executives working in the field. It covers OTP sign-in, daily beat and route planning, retailer check-ins, distributor financials, payment collection and a parts catalog.

Mobile appField salesUI/UX designDashboard
Type
Mobile app
Users
Field sales executives
Role
UI/UX designer
Core flows
Beats, check-ins, payments, orders

What the app covers

Design decisions

  • A single brand blue for headers and primary actions, with white cards on a soft background.
  • Status colours carry meaning: green for completed, amber for due today and red for overdue.
  • Progress is shown as counts (visited, pending) and as a percentage.
  • Financial figures are colour-coded so outstanding amounts stand out.
  • Primary actions sit in full-width buttons that are easy to reach with a thumb.

Outcome

6Core flows in one app: sign-in, beats, check-ins, distributor financials, payments and parts.
3Status colours that carry meaning: green, amber and red.
1Brand blue for every header and primary action.

GitHub project

Clara, AI symptom checker

A mobile AI symptom checker. People describe how they feel in their own words, answer a few follow-up questions and get an urgency level, a suggested next step and an explanation of how the result was reached.

Mobile appConversational UIAI-assistedHealthcare
Type
Installable mobile web app
Flow
Intro, chat, result, reasoning
Hosting
Vercel

Screens

The idea

A conversation, not a form

Checking symptoms usually means forms or long lists. Clara turns it into a short conversation that ends in a clear next step.

Design principles

  • Talk in plain words, with no forms or checkboxes.
  • Ask one follow-up at a time, with quick-reply options.
  • Show the urgency level first, then the care options.
  • Explain the result so it can be trusted.
  • Keep safety copy visible, including the emergency number on results.

Outcome

3Intro screens that explain the idea before the first message.
3Care options on the result: home care, virtual consult and urgent care.
4Signals on the reasoning screen, each with its vote.
LiveDeployed on Vercel.

GitHub project

Pocketbook

A mobile-first expense tracker for personal and family money. It shows balance, income, expenses and a monthly budget in rupees, with upcoming bills, charts and a fast way to add a transaction.

Mobile-firstFintechDashboardDark theme
Type
Installable mobile web app
Theme
Dark, with one violet accent
Hosting
Vercel

Screens

The idea

Personal and shared money in one app

Money is split between personal and shared spending. Pocketbook keeps both in one app with a Mine and Family switch.

Design principles

  • One balance card answers how much is left first.
  • Mine and Family scopes apply on every screen.
  • Budget progress and overdue bills stay on the home screen.
  • Adding a transaction takes a keypad, an amount and a category.
  • Empty states say what to do next.

Outcome

2Views on every screen: Mine and Family.
4Tabs: Home, Transaction, Analytics and Profile.
3Transaction types: income, expense and transfer.
LiveDeployed on Vercel.
